# telnyx_phone_number_block_job (Data Source)

A background job that releases a phone number block, with its status and the numbers that succeeded or failed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.

- `status` (String) Indicates the completion status of the background operation.
